var outputPath = cwd + '/TestSeconds.java';
var improved = originalText2
  .replace('/**\n * Test class.\n */', '/**\n * Tests for {@link Seconds}.\n */')
  .replace('Seconds test = Seconds.ZERO;', 'Seconds zeroSeconds = Seconds.ZERO;')
  .replace('oos.writeObject(test);', 'oos.writeObject(zeroSeconds);')
  .replace('assertSame(test, ois.readObject());', 'assertSame(zeroSeconds, ois.readObject());')
  .replace(/data_valid/g, 'validParseInputs')
  .replace(/data_invalid/g, 'invalidParseInputs')
  .replace(/Seconds test5 = Seconds\.of\(5\);/g, 'Seconds fiveSeconds = Seconds.of(5);')
  .replace(/Seconds test6 = Seconds\.of\(6\);/g, 'Seconds sixSeconds = Seconds.of(6);')
  .replace(/\btest5\b/g, 'fiveSeconds')
  .replace(/\btest6\b/g, 'sixSeconds');
await fsp.writeFile(outputPath, improved, 'utf8');
nodeRepl.write(JSON.stringify({written: outputPath, length: improved.length, replacementsChanged: improved !== originalText2}));
